items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I joined Oliver's band before I went to Shanghai.

ctx.x: Well, I'll let you ask the questions. Alright. Go ahead. How did you happen to join Oliver's band?
Oh. That's right. I joined Oliver's band before I went to Shanghai.
That's right. I'm telling you you're jumping all over. Well, I can't remember all of them. You just ask me the question. I'll tell you. I'll ask you the questions.
